purpose: Teach: 浩二/嶋/死因/船員/楽団/黒澤/柳田/真正面

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長年の、本気で、絶対、浩二、絶対、先生の、絶対、医学論文、絶対、医療界、絶対、参考になっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren — Professor Koji's medical papers have been genuinely invaluable to our clinical work. I mean that sincerely.
lines.style: Measured, professional warmth. Even pacing. Slight pause before 'sincerely' — a moment of genuine gratitude breaking through composure. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学者の、本気で、絶対、嶋、絶対、先生、絶対、ご講演、絶対、私も、絶対、伺いたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I'd very much like to attend Professor Shima's lecture myself. The scholarship in that field is really something.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Slower pace — he's thinking as he speaks. Quiet earnestness underneath. Ends with slight lift, as if offering something genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。診療では、本気で、絶対、死因、絶対、特定、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: In our clinical work, we're very careful about determining cause of death. We don't move forward without being thorough.
lines.style: Clear, deliberate. Each phrase gets weight. No rush. The voice of someone used to precision and consequence. Calm and authoritative without coldness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海運業の、本気で、絶対、船員、絶対、健康管理、絶対、医療チームで、絶対、ご対応されているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The shipping industry does take sailor health seriously — their medical teams coordinate closely with us on those cases.
lines.style: Slightly more engaged than before. Noticing his own interest in the question. Warm but factual. Pace picks up slightly as she settles into the subject.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、楽団、絶対、団員さんの、絶対、健康診断、絶対、当院でも、絶対、引き受けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We also handle health screenings for members of the local orchestra. It's the kind of work we do here.
lines.style: Patient, unhurried. A slight smile in the voice — pride without self-promotion. As if explaining what good practice looks like without needing to announce it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 映画監督の、本気で、絶対、黒澤、絶対、賞、絶対、受賞者の、絶対、医療相談、絶対、貴院で、絶対、対応されたんですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We have consulted with Kurosawa Prize recipients, yes. It's part of the range of care we're called to provide.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. No inflection of awe or importance. She's listing facts the way someone states what their job includes. Brief, clear, honest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。民俗学の、本気で、絶対、柳田、絶対、先生の、絶対、研究、絶対、医療現場でも、絶対、参考になっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Folklorist Yanagita's work on cultural memory actually informs how we approach patient care. There's wisdom in how he understood human experience.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Slow, reflective. She's connecting ideas as she speaks. Gentle conviction — not lecturing, but sharing something she's come to understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病に、本気で、絶対、真正面、絶対、から、絶対、向き合う、絶対、姿勢、絶対、医療チームで、絶対、続けられているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's exactly it — meeting illness head-on with integrity. Our medical team holds to that. It's what matters.
lines.style: Final statement with quiet firmness. Slower, deliberate. As if she's summing up not just the conversation but a whole philosophy of practice. Warm but unshakeable.
